scientific_integrity: The dense-graph distance and persistence claims are supported by symbolic all-parameter arguments; exhaustive finite checks are supplementary. The cycle independence-complex formula is previously known and explicitly attributed.

No general result is asserted for forbidden graphs outside the displayed inequalities.
Independence-cycle homotopy types and abstract graph-power/clique correspondences are classical inputs; the new content is the exact metric transfer and its persistence consequences.

title: Independence-complex transfer and three-periodic Rips barcodes of bipartite factor complements
